sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Support Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
